title: Remove Landing music UI and route YES directly to the final page

requirements.summary: Remove the Landing page background music UI so no music controls render and no background audio element mounts by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page no longer renders the floating music player UI.
No <audio> element for background music is mounted anywhere in the UI by default.
All other Landing page content (heading, subheading, continue button, decorations) remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Remove the MusicPlayer import and the <MusicPlayer /> render from the Landing page while leaving all other content/structure unchanged.
Remove the MusicPlayer component implementation so the background <audio> element and related UI controls cannot be mounted by default.

requirements.summary: Change the proposal YES flow to skip the celebration page and navigate directly to the final page, and remove the celebration route from normal navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the YES button on the proposal page does not navigate to the current celebration page route.
After tapping YES, the app navigates directly to the final page route used for the end of the experience.
The removed/skipped celebration page is not reachable via normal in-app navigation (and any route/table-of-routes is updated accordingly).

file_operations.description: Create a new FinalPage that represents the end of the experience, using the existing celebration content (message/date plan) and shadcn-ui Card/Accordion components for layout (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Update the YES button handler to navigate directly to the final page route (e.g., '/final') instead of the current celebration route.
Wire the new FinalPage into the router as the end-of-experience route and remove the celebration page route/import so it is not reachable through normal in-app routing.
Remove the now-skipped CelebrationPage so there is no in-app route/page for the intermediate heart celebration step.
